scenes: A hacker stole six hundred million dollars. Then he gave it back.
And the company offered him a job.
August twenty twenty-one. Poly Network moved crypto between blockchains.
One bug in its code let a hacker move the money to his own wallets.
Over six hundred ten million dollars. The biggest Dee-fye hack at the time.
Tether froze thirty-three million of it.
Then the hacker started sending it back.
In a message inside a transaction, he called it his effort to help their security.
Poly Network nicknamed him Mister White Hat.
They offered him a five hundred thousand dollar bounty.
And a job: Chief Security Advisor.
Over two hundred million stayed locked. It needed his key and theirs.
On August twenty-third, he handed over the final key.
